scope: Work orchestration, native connector adapters, local host bridge, generated Functions bundle, explicit two-pass Work classification recipe, synthetic fault tests. No production-readiness approval.

closed_findings.resolution: Watchdog binds exact job identity/version/scope/kind and reporting window; unrelated/stale/pending report runs cannot suppress the expected warning. Later reviewed run can satisfy interval while prior pending history remains.

Source completeness separated from report authority in JSON, Markdown and manifests; TASK.md supplies executable two-pass Work classification recipe with evidence/prompt/model/rule/commit metadata and no separate hosted model.
Repeated collector key requires matching listed size and hash; discrepancy preserves raw observations and makes source partial.

Failure evidence retains known created IDs, paths, hashes, verification state, prior successes and ambiguous no-ID creates; post-upload native metadata errors carry known ID; analysis failure best-effort archives acquired raw data.
Explicit reviewed versus unreviewed provenance prevents archived automatic defaults from becoming reviewed on re-ingest. New reviewed observation required; originals retained.
Future or noncanonical/finer precision review timestamps stay pending; only visible canonical millisecond UTC review observations clear pending, preserving original finer-precision records.

additional_hardening: Per-file private sharing checked on upload verification and every read.
Raw malformed mail and available artifacts survive normalization failure.
release_limits: Hosted owner authorization and original-IP provenance remain separate release gates.
Retention controls and full storage recovery are not certified by this review.
Actual unattended full export/archive/report/watchdog and notification paths remain unproven.
Full mailbox pagination, large raw messages and attachments remain live acceptance tests.
Required portable runtime/dependency archive and independent offline recovery remain explicit acceptance work.
Ambiguous no-ID uploads require observed-ID inventory reconciliation without overwrite or deletion.
